profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sketch Development Services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Webster Groves, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Mobile Application Development
- Development of applications via React Native and Typescript.  
- Integrations with GraphQL API, Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Messaging, Remote Config)
- CI/CD for merge request process and build pipeline

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Web applications development.  Front end development in Ruby on Rails.  Back end development in Java using Restful web services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed interfaces between IFS and multiple DoD and Federal government systems using JBoss SOA-P architecture
Integrated SOA interfaces via JMS, web services, file transfer, and databases
Developed custom Java code to facilitate transformations between data formats
Maintained automated unit testing and continuous build integration
Followed Scrum by participating in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives and daily Scrum meetings

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Java applications to automate manual work processes
Created and maintained SAP Business Objects reports, universes, and web services
Developed web dashboards using SAP Xcelsius
Developed integration and verification test cases based on requirement and technical design analysis
Performed and lead integration and requirement validation testing activities
Supported user acceptance testing efforts and lead government witness testing working closely with customers
Provided defect management and test reporting during testing activities

positions.title: Software Engineer Asc
positions.description:
Developed online tools using IBM Mashup Center, HTML, and JavaScript
Built web services using WebMethods and Java servlets
Followed the agile development process Scrum as a team member, participated in sprint developments and daily Scrum meetings

positions.title: College Student Technical Specialist
positions.description:
Developed web based staffing tool using HTML and JavaScript
Implemented database in Oracle and user interface using Grails
Created input scripts using Groovy
Followed Scrum agile development process as a team member and Scrum master, participated in sprint planning and review, daily scrum meetings, and ensured scrum processes were followed

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Developed commercial nodes for the Konstanz Information Miner (KNIME) framework
Implemented user interface using Swing library
Used Scrum development process
Test code with JUnit
